{{Top|leg}}
'''Sha Kalan''' was a temple utilized by the [[Zeison Sha]] for training. It was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yanibar]]. Zeison Sha children who trained there still lived with their parents, though, as Zeison Sha philosophy encouraged a normal family life for children.
